title: Масове розповсюдження стілерів (Formbook, Snake Keylogger) та використання шкідливих програм RelicRace/RelicSource як засобу доставки (CERT-UA#5056)

entities.name: UAC-0041
entities.gloss: A threat group tracked by CERT-UA associated with mass malware distribution campaigns.

entities.name: RelicRace
entities.gloss: A .NET downloader malware designed to fetch, decode, and launch secondary payloads.

entities.name: RelicSource
entities.gloss: A .NET installer and loader malware used to decrypt and execute embedded payloads.

entities.name: Formbook
entities.gloss: An infostealer and spyware malware family sold on underground forums.

entities.name: Snake Keylogger
entities.gloss: A modular .NET-based keylogger and information stealer.

entities.name: OneDrive
entities.gloss: A cloud file storage and synchronization service provided by Microsoft.

entities.name: Telegram
entities.gloss: A cloud-based instant messaging service frequently abused by threat actors for C2 communication.
